entries.description: A homestead producing honey, rare poultry breeds, and craft items, run by 2 lesbians on 22 acres. They welcome other lesbians for apprenticeships and work exchanges, and trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continues from previous page; type is Private/Individual Land because of the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'); acreage is 22; residents is 2; accepted groups inferred Lesbian women; focuses are Farming/self-sufficiency and Workshops/education.

entries.description: An inactive community with hopes to revive, currently cared for by 2 wimmin on 147 acres. They welcome wimmin and children under 10 years, and nonlesbian women, with a rule against alcohol, drugs, or violence.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Community name OWL FARM; contact PO Box; acreage 147; residents 2; type Intentional Community/Cooperative because they are actively recruiting new members/caretakers to revive an existing collective; accepted groups include Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children; Recovery/substance-free focused due to 'No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence'.

entries.description: A land trust supporting OWL Farm and holding trust land, cared for by a fluctuating collective of women. Welcomes new members, girls and boys, and nonlesbian women.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Community name OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST; type Land Trust because it explicitly states 'Land trust meetings' and 'in the process of buying OWL FARM'; accepted groups include Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children.

entries.description: A secluded forest hilltop home of 4 lesbians on 40 acres, making art and song, offering workshops in Theatre and Tai Chi, and unable to accept visitors at other times.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working the land.
entries.notes: Community name FLY AWAY HOME; contact PO Box; acreage 40; residents 4; type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('family of 4 lesbians', 'We have/are: 4 lesbians' with no active recruitment for new resident members); accepted groups Lesbian women (inferred).

entries.description: A partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property, managing woods by thinning and reforestation. Welcomes girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, and male friends.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working the land.
entries.notes: Community name STEPPING WOODS; contact mailing address is a Rural Route ('Rt 4 Box 1058'), so copied to land address; acreage 130; residents 2; type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('partnership of 2 lesbians', '2 lesbians'); accepted groups include Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women, Girl children, Boy children, Non-gay men (due to 'male friends that come on our land').

entries.description: A rural feminist publishing center run by two older women (57 & 60 years old) on 6+ acres with strong interests in photography, ecology, and alternative technology. Strictly substance-free.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Community name ROOTWORKS; mailing address is a street address ('2000 King Mountain Trail'), copied to land address; acreage 6; residents 2; type Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', ages 57 & 60); accepted groups Lesbian women (inferred) and Non-lesbian women; focuses include Older women (ages 57 & 60), Recovery/substance-free ('no... drugs or dope'), Archives/cultural work ('publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image)'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('ecology and alternative technology'); note '$6+' for acreage truncated to '6'.

entries.description: A guest house in Provincetown, MA, listed under an editor's note stating these groups do not have land per se.
entries.raw_text: GABRIEL'S 104 Bradford St, Provincetown, MA 02657 (617)487-3232. Gabriel's is a women's guesthouse located in the center of Provincetown, a resort area on the tip of Cape Cod. We are one block from the nearest beach, have both rooms and apartments, private and shared baths, TVs, a common room, coffee and toast, hot tub and garden patio. Call or write for descriptive brochure. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, males (during off season only, Nov-March). We have/are: housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Not a listing because it appears under the editor's note 'These groups don't have land, per se'.
entries.section: EDITORS' NOTE: These groups don't have land, per se, but we decided to include them for your information.

entries.description: A womyn's rooming/guest house situated on an island off the coast of Maine, listed under an editor's note about groups without land.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES HOME Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5376. We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/are: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Not a listing because it is a guest house under the editor's note for groups without land per se.

entries.description: Notice of legal dissolution and end of the Ozark Wimmin's Land Trust.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing because the community ended in legal dissolution ('The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually').
